full_prompt_en: A square, intricately lined illustration shows a dark-haired woman leaning down toward a pale skull amid a dense field of muted floral pattern. Her head enters from the upper right and turns to the left in a delicate profile, filling much of the image. Thick black hair is gathered into a broad smooth mass, crossed by slim gold chains and an ornate gold ornament with a small blue stone near the upper left. A long gold earring hangs beside her neck, its linked pieces and narrow drops rendered with precise lines. Her pale face has a fine dark brow, downward-looking eye, straight nose, and small warm red lips. The quiet expression contrasts with the dark cavities of the skull at lower left, whose cracked ivory surface and uneven teeth are outlined in brown and black. Her garment rises from the lower right in layered blue and deep teal fabric, covered with small curling motifs and bordered by ochre-gold trim. A narrow necklace or chain descends along the chest. Behind the two main forms, gray-brown blossoms, leaves, and branching lines pack the ground almost to the edges; some dark blue patches create separation from the face and skull. The image has little open space, but its large dark hair mass, pale face, and pale skull remain clearly organized. Fine crosshatching and print-like grain texture the background and clothing, while the face is smoother and lighter. Light is soft and even from the upper left, illuminating pale surfaces and gold details without a hard cast shadow. The overall composition turns two close profiles into an ornamental diagonal, balancing ivory, ink-dark blue, and antique gold within a densely worked surface.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形、线条繁复的插画描绘一位黑发女子，在密集低饱和花纹中俯身望向浅色骷髅。她的头从右上进入，以细致侧面朝左，占据画面大部。浓黑头发收成宽阔平滑的体块，细金链横过其上，左上附近有带小蓝宝石的华丽金饰。长金耳环垂在脖颈旁，相连部件与细坠由精确线条绘出。浅色面庞有细深眉、下视的眼、直鼻和小小暖红嘴唇。宁静神情与左下骷髅的深洞形成对比，后者裂开的象牙色表面与不齐牙齿以褐黑线勾出。衣服从右下升起，为层叠蓝色与深青绿色织物，覆盖细小卷纹，并以赭金饰边。细项链或链条沿胸前垂下。两大主体后，灰褐色花朵、叶片和枝线几乎填到边缘；部分深蓝色块将脸与骷髅从背景中分开。画面留白很少，但宽大深发、浅面庞与浅骷髅仍组织清楚。细密交叉排线和印刷般颗粒给背景与衣料添肌理，脸则更平滑明亮。柔光从左上方均匀落下，照亮浅色表面与金色细节，没有硬边投影。整体构图把两个靠近的轮廓变成装饰性斜线，在密集加工表面中平衡象牙色、墨色深蓝和古金色。
style_prompt_en: The image has an intricate ink-and-color illustration finish, with precise dark contours, fine crosshatching, and antique print-like grain. Large ink-dark and ivory shapes provide a clear hierarchy inside dense interwoven ornament. Muted blue, deep teal, warm beige, gray-brown, and aged gold repeat in small areas, while tiny warm red and bright blue accents sharpen selected points. Edges are crisp in the principal shapes and dissolve into repeated curls, leaves, and filigree-like marks around them. Light is soft and even, expressed through pale reserved areas and restrained gold glints rather than modeled shadows. The space is shallow and crowded, built from overlapping patterned layers. The overall effect is elegant, somber, and richly tactile.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有繁复墨线着色插画的完成面，深色轮廓精确，交叉排线细密，带古旧印刷般颗粒。宽大墨色与象牙色形体在密织装饰中提供清楚层级。低饱和蓝、深青绿、暖米、灰褐和旧金色以小面积重复，极少暖红与亮蓝重音锐化特定点位。主要形体边缘清楚，周围则消融为重复卷线、叶形和金丝般笔迹。光柔和均匀，以预留的浅色区域和克制金光表现，而非塑造阴影。空间浅而拥挤，由叠压花纹层建立。整体效果优雅、沉郁且肌理丰富。
theme_en: An elaborately dressed dark-haired woman looking down toward a pale skull
theme_zh: 一位装饰华丽的黑发女子低头望向浅色骷髅
name: Masami Teraoka
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
